p5.js 2.3.4 (`p5.min.js`), unmodified, from the npm package `p5@2.3.4` (https://p5js.org, LGPL-2.1: see LICENSE-p5.txt).
Served from this site by the p5 playground (`playground-p5/`), so sketches never load anything from a CDN.
To update: `npm pack p5@<version>`, copy `lib/p5.min.js` and `license.txt`, and run the p5 lessons (`npm run check-p5`).
